messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT P1 — eu-west1 autoscaler blocked by GPU quota_exceeded; queue growing quickly (~1.2k). paging: @max @olga

max: on it. autoscaler logs show repeated 'quota_exceeded' for project/redsrv-eu. queuelen 1200 -> 1500 in 5m, lots of 429s/timeouts.

nate: opened GCP case CS-2026-8891 for emergency GPU quota bump, escalated to priority 1.

olga: can we shift non-regulatory/non-lowlatency tenants to eu-west2 or us-west while we remediate? I'll prepare routing policy.

sara: support: 3 enterprise tickets reporting timeouts. Notifying account owners for impacted customers and drafting customer update.

max: short-term mitigations I'm executing:
- enable preemptible backfill pool in eu-west1
- gradual reroute of eligible traffic to us-west2
- rollout quantized lower-memory model variant for burst traffic
- temporarily allow oversubscribe on reserved pool (manual override)

olga: preemptible backfill can add ~10 GPUs, ~6-8m spin-up. starting now.

max: applying circuit-breaker override to permit oversubscribe on cluster.

max: command:
```
redwoodctl cluster update inference-eu-west1 --set autoscaler.allow_oversubscribe=true --reason "quota-mitigation"
```

oncall-bot: Reminder — follow runbook 'quota-hit-mitigation' steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quota-hit-mitigation

nate: parallel: rolling out smaller/quantized model canary across EU edge nodes to reduce GPU memory pressure.

olga: starting 20% gradual reroute of eligible (non-PII, best-effort) traffic to us-west2. Monitoring metrics.

max: autoscaler logs after override: backfill claimed 6 preemptible GPUs. queue dropped 1200 -> 700 over ~6m.

sara: customer update posted to affected channels; account teams looped in.

cloud-support-bot: CS-2026-8891: "temporary quota increase under review; estimate ~2h for formal approval".

olga: queue 380, error rate 7%, p95 latency 3.2s. Keeping oversubscribe until queue <100 or cloud confirms quota change.

max: logging note for postmortem: autoscaler did not automatically reroute when quota_exceeded occurred — fallback path missing.

sara: impact summary for execs: peak ~12% request failures, ~300k tokens/hr delayed, top affected customers: CustA, CustB, CustC. No billing ingestion issues.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled: @olga takes oncall in 30m (1709504268). Please post status updates every 10m until resolved.

olga: taking over. next update in 10m. will maintain overrides until safe.

max: follow-up: create ticket to implement automatic cross-region reroute on quota_exceeded and add quota-health alerting.

sara: action items: finalize customer comms, update runbook, implement autoscaler fallback, and perform SLA exposure review.

cloud-support-bot: CS-2026-8891 update: "escalated to account team; awaiting approval" :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olga: dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/instances/eu-west1/queue

max: final check: queue 85, errors 1.5%, latency 2.1s. Preparing to remove oversubscribe override once confirmed safe.

olga: will close thread after quota confirmation or when fully drained. thanks team.
